summary: Smoke test on cloned Celesta Glow repo. All critical flows pass: homepage matches reference (desktop+mobile), 4 products listed (/product/sunscreen, /product/under-eye-cream, /product/anti-aging-serum, /product/anti-aging-cream), product detail renders, add-to-cart works (cart shows 1 item for SPF 50 Sunscreen with pricing), /doctors /services /pro render without React errors, admin login at /admin with password 'celestaglow2024' succeeds and redirects to /admin/dashboard which loads full admin panel. Backend endpoints /api/products and /api/mp/categories return 200.

issues: Non-blocking React dev warnings: duplicate keys in product/category lists ('Encountered two children with the same key'), UNSAFE_componentWillMount from a dependency, 'fetchpriority' DOM prop casing warning. Does not affect functionality but should be cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3893 lines — exceeds the recommended 700-line limit; already partially modularized into /routes but main file still huge. Future refactor recommended.
React 'duplicate key' warnings on homepage indicate list rendering uses non-unique keys (likely product/category .map). Harmless but should be fixed for correctness.
Third-party keys (Razorpay, Cloudinary, SMTP, Google Maps) are not configured as per request; admin dashboard already surfaces the Cloudinary warning banner — expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a straight clone and smoke-tests cleanly against public URL https://celest-replica.preview.emergentagent.com. 4 products are seeded. Admin endpoint accepts {password: 'celestaglow2024'} at POST /api/admin/login. For AI/payment/email features, keys are intentionally missing — do not flag as bugs.
